records.requirement: Stable identities, ordered ownership, rename, duplication, reparent and deletion
remainingDesign: General deletion repair, duplicate-with-motion remapping, cross-page references, inactive-node cleanup and reparent conversion policy
proofObligations: Rename/reparent preserve addressed references; duplicate remaps without collisions

records.requirement: Reusable definitions and placed component instances have distinct ownership
relationships: parameters belong to instance or definition
remainingDesign: Definition discovery, adapter-owned external bodies, conditional edit points, public interface exposure, general extraction repair and version migration admission
proofObligations: One instance edit preserves other instances and definition source

records.requirement: Smart defaults and local overrides preserve typed references and reset by absence
relationships: kind CreationProfile -> definition body -> eligible instance override -> scene evaluated motion
remainingDesign: Defaults for sequence/scene/media records and conditional/layout-dependent consumers; profile support for non-root parts
proofObligations: Literal zero survives; reset removes binding and restores default/reference; invalid present value refuses

records.requirement: Designer and Animator share authored token sources in the same Git project
relationships: bindings address source and token path
remainingDesign: DTCG import/export coverage, alias and composite validation, Resolver contexts, watching, collisions and unsaved-source custody
proofObligations: Source round trip preserves references/metadata; token update reaches both views; cycle/missing ref rejects atomically

records.requirement: Workspace pages, application pages, frames and reusable components remain distinct
remainingDesign: Application route/doc object representation and adapter-owned source mappings
proofObligations: Creating frame/page changes no application route or component source

records.requirement: A scene is a local temporal composition referencing a visual root
relationships: composition -> explicit local members and root
instance -> shared definition; local bindings and supplied slots
remainingDesign: Scene creation/duplication and reusable composition instances; simultaneous evaluation isolation and storyboard representative sampling
proofObligations: Editing one independent composition does not mutate another consumer; deliberate composition sharing shares base edits while scene tracks remain isolated

records.requirement: Sequences arrange identified scene occurrences independently of storyboard layout
relationships: occurrence references scene and trim interval
proofObligations: Repeated scene uses distinct occurrence identities; trims map to declared scene-local time

records.requirement: Transitions explicitly connect occurrences and declare cross-scene continuity
remainingDesign: Overlap, blend, correspondence, shared-root isolation, lifecycle and retained state across transitions
proofObligations: Cut obeys intervals; future continuity never inferred from labels or definition reuse

records.requirement: Authored base values remain separate from evaluated animated values
relationships: selected property key owns its authored value
last key -> derived terminal hold; no saved base mutation
proofObligations: Static scenes and implicit/explicit starts match independent samples; selected-key edits preserve base; terminal hold and scrubbing never author values

records.requirement: Timing has explicit units, a timebase, scene-local keys and token time movement policy
relationships: scene local time -> sequence occurrence time
remainingDesign: Frame/rational sampling, rounding, interpolation precision, token time bounds reconciliation and recipe retiming
proofObligations: Independent linear samples match the worked expectations; time-token changes move addressed keys and report order/bounds incompatibility without resizing the scene

records.requirement: Competing tracks produce a declared inspectable result
remainingDesign: Semantic writer/order/bounds validation, additive/blended motion and interval composition
proofObligations: Initial subset rejects simultaneous writers before evaluation rather than using array order

records.requirement: Translation presets retain recipe, instance parameters and derived tracks separately
remainingDesign: Recipe schema/versioning, default directions and offsets, regeneration, manual edits and parameter binding
proofObligations: Changing recipe application does not overwrite unrelated hand-authored keys

records.requirement: Triggers, presence, cancellation, reversal and interruption preserve preview/output agreement
remainingDesign: Trigger ownership, policy vocabulary, active-time pauses, loops, fill and interruption across mounts
proofObligations: Reverse-from-current and cancellation probes use independent time/position observations

records.requirement: Storyboard and focused scene view address the same document objects and edits
remainingDesign: Storyboard sampling/navigation/selection retention, auto-key and multi-key editing
proofObligations: Equivalent edits yield equal semantic state; collapsing timeline changes no authored object

records.requirement: Each scratch page uses revision-checked complete accepted JSONL transactions
remainingDesign: Operation admission, complete graph mutation algebra, schema migrations, stale/deduplicated writes and rejected-request audit
proofObligations: Reject stale/duplicate/malformed request without partial mutation; replay restores semantic state

records.requirement: Interruption recovery and durable history storage preserve identities and bindings
remainingDesign: Recovery, branch history, compaction, torn append/fsync, pending edits and cross-file saves
proofObligations: Crash fault injection yields prior or complete next revision; redo preserves references

records.requirement: Canvas creation and preview do not automatically materialize code
proofObligations: New nodes generate no files; executing reviewed plan targets only selected roots/revision

records.requirement: Actual project components render with their own providers, styles, assets and build pipeline
relationships: adapter maps document addresses to supported component consumers
remainingDesign: Capability manifest, entrypoints/provider context, instance isolation, command authorization and server ownership
proofObligations: Fresh user project preserves distinct instances; attached server survives editor close

records.requirement: Persisted code edits target supported authoring sources and report source/runtime revisions separately
relationships: adapter maps edits to upstream source
remainingDesign: Source maps, generated-source policy, stale-source conflicts, external reflection and failed rebuild states
proofObligations: Contract edit survives two regenerations and fresh reopen; stale write refuses; saved source can coexist with failed preview

records.requirement: Responsive layout, authored geometry and measured geometry remain distinguishable
remainingDesign: Solver semantics, flex/grid/constraints, intrinsic sizing, percentage/relative units, reparent and world/local transforms
proofObligations: Resize preserves chosen constraints and per-instance edits; measurements never become saved defaults

records.requirement: Freeform vectors and editable text have durable structured representations
remainingDesign: Paths/control points, winding, strokes, rich text/runs, typography, font resolution, shaping and fallback
proofObligations: Point/text edit, grouping, undo/redo and reopen preserve editable content

records.requirement: Paints, masks, clipping and procedural effects retain identities, order and parameters
relationships: ordered paint/effect stack belongs to node
remainingDesign: Multiple/disabled paints, independently linked corners, color spaces, gradients, blends, masks and effect order
proofObligations: Disabled paint remains authored; unsupported effect preserves definition and reports unavailable

records.requirement: Media, audio and compositing support explicit source time, trim and output settings
relationships: media asset source time maps into scene/sequence
remainingDesign: Media assets, rational frame/sample time, trim, masks/effect order, audio mixing, alpha and codec/output profiles
proofObligations: Fresh media trim samples expected source time; missing asset blocks complete output

records.requirement: Code output carries intended semantics, content roles, interactions and reduced-motion behavior
remainingDesign: Document roles/reading order, labels, interaction/data bindings, focus/navigation and motion preference context
proofObligations: Output preserves declared semantics; property animation respects independently selected reduced-motion policy

records.requirement: Missing dependencies and library updates preserve overrides and reveal affected uses
remainingDesign: Content-addressed custody, relocation, pin/update admission and atomic dependency/source/page edits
proofObligations: Incompatible update identifies affected instances/tracks and does not delete bindings

records.requirement: Human and agent edits use the same supported operations, locks and ownership checks
relationships: shared mutation boundary validates all routes
remainingDesign: Transport/authentication, permission/session model, locks, operation admission and audit of rejected requests
proofObligations: UI/agent equivalent operation has equivalent ownership/history; locked or stale edit rejects

records.requirement: Stored representation stays independent of frameworks and preserves editable source meaning
remainingDesign: Version/migration policy, extension registry, packaging, supported external format mappings and round-trip fidelity
proofObligations: Exchange recovers authored fields and references; renderer framework objects never enter persisted core

records.requirement: Imported and derived data retain inspectable origin without inferring intent from evaluated values
relationships: import source relates to authored candidates
remainingDesign: Source provenance, import confidence, stable source correspondence and authored-versus-resolved classification
proofObligations: Import of values equal to defaults does not silently claim explicit override intent

records.requirement: Object/property keys use composition-backed starts, explicit key selection and terminal hold without snapshotting whole scenes
proofObligations: Independent static/base-edit/selected-key/explicit-start/last-key-removal and visibility observations match authored tables; scrubbing changes no base state

records.requirement: Bounded accepted edits and compensating undo/redo preserve authored identities references and absence
remainingDesign: Inverse execution and before-image custody, dependency-conflicting undo, cross-page history and branch semantics
proofObligations: Undo/redo preserves exact identifiers and references; stale or dependent inverse changes nothing

records.requirement: CreationProfile CreationGesture and TextEditSession separate provisional gestures from authored nodes
proofObligations: Point frame inherits100x100; drag authors128x36; canceled text or drag inserts nothing

records.requirement: PropertyConsumer supplies typed role and effective-kind addresses independently of rendered internals
remainingDesign: Conditional consumers, external adapter mapping and complete public exposure
proofObligations: Frame-root instance token eligibility follows declared frame/fill consumer, never wrapper name

records.requirement: DefinitionBody DefinitionPlacement and ExtractionCorrespondence preserve reusable visual ownership
remainingDesign: General extraction reference repair and external/adapted definitions
proofObligations: Button/Banner extraction preserves appearance refs and selected placement identity; nested Button never flattens

records.requirement: ProjectChange coordinates page and shared-source expected revisions and declared effects
relationships: project envelope -> page/source participants and dependency selection
remainingDesign: Durable publication protocol, execution/admission and cross-file reconciliation
proofObligations: Tokenize-and-bind and extraction accept all participants or none against expected revisions

records.requirement: FontResolutionAndShaping: Real fonts, missing-font handling, shaping, wrapping and measured geometry
remainingDesign: Real fonts, missing-font handling, shaping, wrapping and measured geometry
proofObligations: Fresh font/fallback probes preserve authored font refs and independently observed layout

records.requirement: CanvasHitTestingAndSnapping: Ambiguous hit destinations, snapping, rotated/overlapping/locked objects and coordinate conversion beyond fixture
remainingDesign: Ambiguous hit destinations, snapping, rotated/overlapping/locked objects and coordinate conversion beyond fixture
proofObligations: Zoom-independent creation and ambiguous/locked hit refusal use actual gestures

records.requirement: DefinitionInterfaceExposure: Deliberate promotion of body text properties and children into stable public parameters/slots
remainingDesign: Deliberate promotion of body text properties and children into stable public parameters/slots
proofObligations: Public exposure preserves source ownership and supported instance edit limits

records.requirement: GeneralExtractionReferenceRepair: Animations, external/cross-page references and extraction of arbitrary graphs
remainingDesign: Animations, external/cross-page references and extraction of arbitrary graphs
proofObligations: Extract/revert retargets supported refs; unsupported animated/external refs refuse atomically

records.requirement: AdvancedLayoutResolution: Wrapping, intrinsic constraints, overflow, responsive sizing and broader unit conversion
remainingDesign: Wrapping, intrinsic constraints, overflow, responsive sizing and broader unit conversion
proofObligations: Independent resize/overflow/world-local probes preserve authored constraints

records.requirement: TokenScopeEvolution: Scope migrations after changes, unknown metadata versions and foreign-tool editing
remainingDesign: Scope migrations after changes, unknown metadata versions and foreign-tool editing
proofObligations: Scope round trip preserves eligibility; incompatible later uses are reviewed without deletion

records.requirement: ProjectChangeDurability: Coordinated logs, crash recovery, durable commit, external edits and multi-file reconciliation
remainingDesign: Coordinated logs, crash recovery, durable commit, external edits and multi-file reconciliation
proofObligations: Crash fault injection yields complete prior/next state with pending work preserved

records.requirement: DefinitionSourceAdapter: Visual-definition mapping to actual FSDS or external project authoring sources
remainingDesign: Visual-definition mapping to actual FSDS or external project authoring sources
proofObligations: Source edit survives generation twice and fresh reopen with revision agreement

records.requirement: PreviewAndOutputAgreement: Independent rendering, adapter fidelity and source/prototype/output agreement
remainingDesign: Independent rendering, adapter fidelity and source/prototype/output agreement
proofObligations: Preview and output independently agree on supported visual/motion/source facts
